tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_list_rewards
tools.description: List the rewards in the loyalty programme: name, price in points, tier, availability and whether each can be purchased. Pass userToken to see the rewards that customer may view. Use the filter purchasable:(eq:!t) to hide rewards that cannot be bought. White Label Loyalty API: GET /rewards.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_get_reward
tools.description: Get one reward by id: description, points cost, stock, availability window, tier and discounts. White Label Loyalty API: GET /rewards/{id}.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_get_my_wallet
tools.description: Get the loyalty wallet of the customer behind userToken: points balance, tier and progress to the next tier, and vouchers. White Label Loyalty API: GET /users/me/wallet.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_get_my_wallet_predictions
tools.description: Get points liability predictions for the customer behind userToken: spend and earn caps and points expiry. White Label Loyalty API: GET /users/me/wallet/predictions.

tools.name: whitelabelloyalty_purchase_reward
tools.description: Purchase a reward for the customer behind userToken. If the reward has a points cost, that many points are deducted from the wallet. Not idempotent: a repeat call buys again. Only call it when the customer asked for this reward. White Label Loyalty API: POST /commands/purchase_reward.
